- The `Difference(follows, mute)` composition exists only in the Rust Android/desktop/TUI shells of the newest worktrees (`chirp/.wt-*`, branch chirp-android-platform 7be5d64). Its `home_feed_params` = RootIndexed / primary_kinds [1] / admission All. Also sound per my test.
- The stale `/Users/pablofernandez/Work/chirp` checkout calls `register_op_feed_defaults` which no longer exists at the pin — that checkout can't build against pinned NMP; ignore it. [...] - The iOS device home feed uses PLAIN `ActiveUserFollows`, built in Swift (`KernelBridge+FeedOperations.swift:51`), NOT the difference composition. My `control` test proves that path is sound.
